title: THE PRICE OF A WATCH
lesson: Don't trade what's priceless for something shiny
hook:
HE SOLD IT
FOR A WATCH
caption: Ever traded something priceless for something shiny? THE RULE BOOK Ep 26 (Day 6/80): Clyde asked Solo straight up who engraved the watch. The Collector. Solo sold him his pages for it. Clyde: ok but... it IS a nice watch. Score: SOLO 3, US 4. Then Clyde checked the tracker app. POV: you're the villain but Clyde keeps checking your dot. A) Split up B) Hide in the market. A or B? Comment CAST ME to join the story. #liferules #greed #pov #stickman

lines: WHO GAVE YOU THIS WATCH? SPEAK.
YOU SOLD THE BOOK FOR A WATCH?!
IT WAS A REALLY NICE WATCH.
...NO CAP, IT IS A NICE WATCH.
NICE WATCH. CAN'T BUY BACK 20 YEARS.
BET. LEMME CHECK WHAT IT'S WORTH.
WE'RE COOKED. HIS DOT IS BEHIND U-
